persona: The user's INHERENT pre-conversation state (self-reported before the dialogue): The user's underlying problem, in their own words: Work at restaurant as assistant manager. Manager got fired and company asked me to take over position without a pay raise then skipped the promotion and hired a new manager. Presenting problem: job crisis (predominant emotion: anxiety). The seeker self-reported an initial emotional intensity of 4 out of 5 (pre-dialogue).
scenario: A text-chat emotional support session: the supporter listens, empathizes, and helps the seeker explore and reappraise their problem. The seeker's stated issue: job crisis.

reference_transcript.text: Hello?
Hello, how can I help you today?
I don't know what to do. I want to quit and punch the new manager in the face.
So if I understand correctly, you are upset with your job and your manager?
The company mostly and myself for having to work there.
I can't quit because I have bills to pay and it will be hard to find other job right now.
I am sorry to hear that. I can imagine it is challenging to work at a place where you are unhappy. And I understand it is a tough time right now.
Yes, it is. And the new manager is useless! He does not appreciate my efforts at all and I know more than him.

Yes, I can totally relate! I have been there. I was in a very similar situation at a previous job when departments were reorganized and I ended up working for someone who wasn't familiar with my work. It was a challenge and frustrating.

While I know jobs are scarce right now, do you think you might consider at least taking a look at some job sites, doing some searches just to see if there are some other jobs you might be interested in?
Yes, that's really frustrating. I find myself biting my tongue more than once every day when I hear his opinions about the work.
Oh yes, I totally get that! I remember having to do the exact same thing, very frustrating!
Yes, I have done it. I might try writing alternatives and see if that helps.
I used to journal when I was younger but stopped doing when I started working.

That is a great idea! And there are job sites such as indeed and others you can search to see what jobs are available. You never know. I just know how challenging it is to be in a situation where you are unhappy with your job.
I will look into that site. I will have to update my resume as well.
Journaling is an excellent idea!! It has helped me a lot! It can help you discover things you might not have otherwise thought about.
That sounds great! Yes, updating your resume is important.
I agree. It is just hard to fit it in when you're always working.

I totally get understand that! I know you are in a challenging situation now. But you have come up with some great ideas and you sound very intelligent! I believe in you and feel things will get better for you!
Thanks a lot for that. I feel encouraged and a little better now. I can regain control of things if I focus on the solutions.
Have a great day!
Absolutely! That is great! Thank you so much! I hope you have a great day as well! And good luck to you! :)

cognitive_style: I move when I feel GENUINELY understood: real listening calms my anxiety about work, while being pushed toward solutions shuts me down. I form plans only when I truly feel heard. Change comes from my own slow reappraisal.
